[[Reaper's Blade]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] dropped by [[Reaper of Agony]], a [[boss]] who can be found in the [[Depths of Madness]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance:20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Rusty Machete]] [[dye]]d black.
